title: One clear focal point per view
hook: If everything shouts, nothing is heard.
insight: Users scan in a few hundred milliseconds. Size, weight, contrast and whitespace decide what they see first.
rules: Use at most three type sizes per section
do: Make the primary button the highest-contrast element
dont: Give every card the same visual weight
Use more than one accent color for emphasis

title: Concentric radii
hook: Nested corners should share a center.
insight: Equal radii on nested shapes look pinched at the corners. Subtracting padding keeps curves parallel.
rules: If padding exceeds the outer radius, use radius 0 inside
do: Derive inner radii from a token
dont: Copy the same radius onto parent and child

title: Semantic color tokens
hook: Name colors by job, not by hue.
insight: Tokens like --danger and --surface make theming and dark mode a redefinition rather than a rewrite.
rules: Never rely on color alone to convey state
do: Pair color with an icon or label
dont: Hardcode hex values in components

title: Consistent SVG icons
insight: Emoji render differently per platform and cannot be themed, sized or aligned reliably.
rules: One icon set, one stroke width
Icon-only buttons need an accessible name
dont: Use emoji as buttons or status markers

title: Progressive disclosure
hook: Show the common path, tuck away the rest.
insight: Hiding advanced options reduces cognitive load while keeping power users one step away.
rules: Label the disclosure by what it reveals
Keep state when collapsed and reopened
do: Use 'Advanced options' with a count of hidden settings
dont: Bury required fields behind a toggle

title: Optimistic updates
insight: For low-risk actions the interface can update immediately and reconcile with the server, making it feel instant.
rules: Roll back with a clear message on failure
Never optimistic for payments or deletions without undo
do: Show the new state at once and sync quietly
dont: Leave the user guessing after a silent rollback

title: Undo beats confirm dialogs
hook: Don't ask 'are you sure?'. Make it safe.
insight: Confirmation dialogs get dismissed by habit. A visible undo handles mistakes without friction.
rules: Undo window of at least 6 seconds
Reserve confirm dialogs for irreversible actions
Name the object in the confirm button
dont: Use 'OK / Cancel' as button labels

title: Visible drag affordances
insight: Drag handles, cursors and lift states communicate that an element is movable and where it can land.
rules: Show a handle and grab cursor
do: Offer move up/down buttons for accessibility
dont: Make drag the only way to reorder

title: Inline validation on blur
hook: Tell people while they can still fix it.
insight: Validating after the field loses focus catches mistakes early without scolding mid-typing.
rules: Validate on blur, re-validate on input once errored
Place the message adjacent to the field
do: Say how to fix: 'Use at least 8 characters'
dont: Clear the field on error
Show errors before the user has interacted

title: Single-column forms
insight: Multi-column forms break the scan path and raise completion errors.
rules: Mark optional rather than required when most are required
do: Use input types and autocomplete attributes
dont: Use placeholders as labels

title: Submit guard
insight: Slow networks lead to double-clicks and duplicate orders. Disable and show pending state at once.
rules: Use idempotency keys on the server for payments
do: Restore the button if the request fails
dont: Rely on a spinner without disabling

title: Smart defaults
hook: The best field is the one they don't fill.
insight: Pre-filling from context, locale and history removes effort and errors.
dont: Pre-check consent boxes

title: Toasts for passive confirmation
insight: Toasts suit low-stakes confirmations. Errors needing action belong inline.
rules: Auto-dismiss in 4-6 seconds unless it has an action
dont: Put critical errors only in a toast

title: Skeleton loading
hook: Show the shape of what's coming.
insight: Skeletons that match final layout reduce perceived wait and layout shift.
rules: Delay display by ~150ms to avoid flashes
Fall back to a spinner for unknown layouts
dont: Animate skeletons aggressively

title: Doherty threshold
insight: Below roughly 400ms people feel in flow. Beyond it, they need signs of progress.
rules: Determinate progress when length is known
do: Press states on every tappable element
dont: Leave a click with no visible reaction

title: Useful empty states
insight: An empty screen is the best onboarding moment: explain the value and offer the first action.
rules: Say what belongs here and why
Differentiate first-use, no-results and cleared states
dont: Show just 'No data'

title: Errors that help recover
hook: Say what happened, what's safe, what next.
insight: People forgive failure when work is preserved and the next step is clear.
rules: Use plain language, no codes up front
dont: Show stack traces or 'Something went wrong' alone

title: Verb-first action labels
insight: Specific verbs reduce hesitation and errors compared with generic labels.
rules: Match the label to the confirmation title
dont: Mix 'Delete', 'Remove' and 'Discard' for the same action

title: Plain-language microcopy
hook: Write for the person, not the system.
insight: Short, concrete, human sentences outperform jargon and blame-y messages.
rules: Keep to one idea per sentence
dont: 'Error 401: Unauthorized'

title: Locale-aware numbers and dates
insight: Currency, dates and separators differ by locale; tabular numerals keep columns aligned.
do: Show relative time with absolute on hover
dont: Hardcode $ or MM/DD/YYYY

title: Persistent, labeled navigation
insight: Highlighting the current location and labeling items removes wayfinding effort.
rules: Mark the active item with more than color
Use breadcrumbs for depth beyond two levels
dont: Use icon-only nav without labels or tooltips

title: Thumb-zone navigation on mobile
hook: Put primary actions where thumbs land.
insight: Bottom tab bars and bottom sheets are reachable one-handed on large phones.
rules: Place primary action in the lower third
Keep destructive actions out of easy reach
dont: Hide core navigation in a top-left hamburger

title: Search with visible filters
hook: Let people narrow without losing context.
insight: Showing active filters as removable chips keeps state legible and reversible.
dont: Reset scroll or filters on every change

title: Calibrated entrances
insight: Entrances of 200-300ms with ease-out feel responsive; longer reads as lag.
rules: Stagger siblings by 30-50ms, cap total at 400ms
dont: Animate width, height, top or left

title: Exits faster than entrances
insight: Dismissals should not hold the user up; about 60-70% of the entrance duration works.
dont: Reuse the entrance duration

title: Respect reduced motion
hook: Motion is optional for the user.
insight: Vestibular disorders make parallax and large movement harmful. Replace with instant or fade states.
rules: Never autoplay looping motion without a pause control
Keep essential feedback via color or text
dont: Disable feedback entirely

title: Shared-element continuity
insight: Morphing a card into its detail view preserves orientation across a context change.
rules: Fall back to fade if unsupported
do: Use the View Transitions API where available
dont: Animate unrelated elements simultaneously

title: Visible focus rings
insight: A clear ring with offset shows position and is a WCAG requirement.
do: Trap focus inside modals and restore on close
dont: Set outline: none without a replacement

title: 44px touch targets
insight: Small targets cause mis-taps; invisible padding can enlarge hit area without changing the look.
do: Expand hit areas with padding or pseudo-elements
dont: Place destructive and safe actions flush together
